author: Good Enough
description:
The largest gold nugget ever discovered was sitting just 1 inch underground.

In 1869, two prospectors in Australia uncovered what became known as the “Welcome Stranger,” the biggest gold nugget ever found. What makes it even more unbelievable is how close it was to the surface, something that could have been missed by almost anyone.

This Short tells the story of how life-changing wealth was hiding just beneath the ground.

#gold #facts
title: Largest Gold Nugget Ever... 1 Inch Down 🥇😳 #history #americanhistory #unbelievable

author: Good Enough
description:
He didn’t mine for gold, but still made millions during the Gold Rush.

During the California Gold Rush, Samuel Brannan became one of the richest men not by digging for gold, but by selling supplies to the thousands of prospectors rushing in. While others searched for fortune, he capitalized on the demand and built massive wealth from it.

This Short tells the story of how the smartest move during the Gold Rush wasn’t mining, it was selling to the miners.

#goldrush
title: He Didn't Mine Gold... But Made Millions 🥇💰 #didyouknow #history #americanhistory #facts
